refactor: supervise dispatch runtime workers

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-16
  description: |-
    Move execution-runtime candidate and reconciliation work behind a bounded supervisor so provider calls cannot block scheduler fairness. Persist worker lifecycle evidence, fence stale completions, isolate worker faults and panics, and cancel exact dispatch runtimes during bounded shutdown while retaining global fail-closed invariants.
